ai_review.summary: A solid 1971 performance captured on a surprisingly clear sound‑board source that outshines many other SBD recordings from the era.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate this concert four stars, highlighting a “pretty good” show and a recording that sounds better than most 1971 SBDs despite the known limitations of that year’s board mixes. The sound is described as clear and enjoyable, while the performance is deemed a strong showing at a classic venue.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 4‑star reviews praise both musical and technical aspects; the rating reflects a good show with above‑average recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note this SBD sounds a bit better than other 1971 board recordings, despite typical era limitations (Bear's departure). No major flaws reported.
